parts.text:
A small handoff, in three parts.

The source includes café, 漢字, and a family 👩‍👩‍👧‍👦. They do not all cost the same number of bytes. A

visible character can be several code points working together.

Keep every space. Keep the line breaks.  Even these two spaces have a place. Try a byte budget,

then switch to graphemes and see where the boundaries move.

One final detail: joining the parts adds no separator. It should recover this exact text.
